facts.premium: One of Isan's most informal provinces (~91%); among the lowest incomes nationally.
facts.skill_gap: Very thin formal sector; smallholder farming and self-employment dominate.
anchors: Famous local produce (durian, shallots) and rural markets
impacts: Rain-dependent rice and field crops; weather drives the repayment cycle.
Shallot/garlic and cassava prices swing widely, destabilising smallholder income.
Firm jasmine-rice prices help cushion the dominant rice income.
Heavy outward migration; local cash flow tracks transfers from elsewhere.
Fleet is moto-led with modest pickup share; thin-ticket lending profile.
